In this video, I’m sharing the hard truths about Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) that most people don’t hear until it’s too late, and what to do instead.

As an ex-Google recruiter, I’ve seen how these systems really work. If you're in a PIP, or worried one is coming, this video will help you protect your reputation, career, and peace of mind.

 YOU’LL LEARN:
 • Why most PIPs aren’t really second chances
 • Early warning signs you’re being set up
 • Whether to fight the PIP — or leave strategically
 • The exit plan smart professionals use
